blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Draft vs release
blocks.body:
Oxygen can still build WebHelp or PDF on your laptop. That is a **draft**. You used that in week 6.

On a Guides shop, **Guides publish** is the release. It uses a **baseline** :  a named snapshot of the book :  so everyone knows which version shipped. Verify the wording on your desk.

Sites **Quick Publish** activates a web page. It is not a DITA output. Do not put it on this list.

If you have no Guides, write ‘mock’ and do not invent a button.

blocks.q: A local WebHelp from Oxygen is the release of record on a Guides shop. True or not?
options: True :  if the HTML opened, it shipped
Not true :  the server baseline is the release. Local is a draft
True if you named the folder FINAL
blocks.why: You learned local WebHelp in week 6. On a Guides shop, that build is a draft.

blocks.q: Sites Quick Publish is a DITA output. True or not?
options: Not true :  Quick Publish activates an AEM web page. Guides publish ships the handbook
blocks.why: Two desks. Two publish buttons. Do not mix them.
